name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Endpointy (Endpoints) tab
description:
## Why?

The Endpoints tab controls what API data an addon may read and write. It is the security-relevant tab of the page: wrong access checkboxes mean an addon gets rights it was never granted. It also pulls in two separate modal controllers.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/Endpoints.tpl` and `sub/ServiceDetail/EndpointAccess.tpl` to React, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partials.

Covers the endpoint-group table with `endpointAccess[groupId][]` read/write checkboxes, the delete actions `?action=deleteEndpoint&groupId=&apiServiceId=` and `?action=deleteEndpointModification`, and the two modals opened from this tab: `PartnerServiceEndpoints` (endpoint-group detail) and `PartnerServiceEndPointModify` (access change request).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Endpoint-group table renders with correct read/write state per group, including pending modification rows
- `endpointAccess[groupId][]` values `read` and `write` post unchanged
- `deleteEndpoint` and `deleteEndpointModification` work with the legacy confirmation and redirect
- Both modals open and submit correctly; their controllers are not modified beyond what the Inertia bridge requires
- Rights resolution matches the legacy page for a service with granted, requested and revoked groups
- Every `data-testid` from `Endpoints.tpl` and `EndpointAccess.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- Legacy partials deleted and bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green
